prompt:
You receive 5 images. Image 1 is the LAYOUT SKETCH of the finished 1920x1080 game screen: a crude flat-colour blocking that fixes the exact composition - camera, horizon, wall and floor lines, and the position, size and outline of every object. Repaint image 1 into a finished painting: keep every line and every block exactly where it is and exactly as large as it is, paint each block as the object described below, do not move, enlarge, shrink, add or remove anything, and leave no flat colour areas or hard geometric edges. Images 2-4 are photos of the real place (geography, architecture, materials and real details to paint from; they are references only, do not copy their camera, cars, people, signs or weather). Image 5 is a finished background painting from our game: use it ONLY as the reference for the painting technique (brushwork, palette, edge softness, level of detail, line quality); do not copy anything from its scene.

Place: the boarding hall of the real Funitel valley station at Priehyba (1,342 m) in Jasná, Low Tatras, Slovakia. Image 2 is a photo of this hall: the galvanised steel guide rail with a long row of black conveyor tyres overhead, the red bullwheel, black Funitel cabins on twin hangers docked along the rail, a red steel frame, an open concrete floor. Image 3 shows the station from outside (dark glass and metal, the red band with CHOPOK). Image 4 is an approved painting from our game of the same hall (keep its look: black cabins, red steel frame, light concrete floor, daylight from the open sides). Paint this real place.

Brief: the real transfer point: the passengers arrive by the gondola from Biela Púť and board the Funitel Priehyba–Chopok here. Recognisable lift architecture, the attendant Ivan, a small map of the two sections. Wednesday 6 June 2035, bright midday daylight falling into the hall from the open sides, cool grey shade inside.

Camera: standing on the boarding platform, about 1.6 m high, looking across the hall at the docked cabins, the cabins parallel to the picture; vertical lines stay vertical; the horizon is at y ~470. Keep this exact geometry from the sketch: the guide rail with its tyres across the hall at y 120-230; cabin 1 at x 300-680 (top y 345, floor y 700) with closed doors; cabin 2 at x 830-1270 (top y 325, floor y 705) with its doors slid open in the middle (x 960-1160); the platform edge with a yellow safety line at y ~712-724; the steel handrail along the edge (top rail y 618) with a gap for the boarding gate at x 925-1155; the concrete pillar with the map board at x 1430-1670; the red steel frame at the right edge; the open passage with daylight at the left edge; the concrete platform from y 720 to the bottom edge.

What the sketch blocks are: the dark steel roof structure with beams; the galvanised guide rail with the row of black conveyor tyres; the concrete back wall; the open passage with daylight at the left end of the hall (towards the gondola arrival); the big red bullwheel partly visible behind cabin 1; the twin hanger arms of the cabins; two big black Funitel cabins with large tinted windows and grey frames, no livery, no logo, no lettering on them; the lit interior of cabin 2 through its open doors (a padded bench and handrails); a hanging sign with the word CHOPOK and an arrow; the concrete pillar; the red steel frame; the concrete platform with the yellow safety line.

Interactive props - each painted clearly inside its block, the same size as its block, easy to recognise at a glance:
1. the block of the layout sketch at x 330-890, y 610-715 of the 1920x1080 frame (17-46 % from the left, 56-66 % from the top): a sturdy brushed-steel handrail (two rails on round posts) along the platform edge in front of cabin 1.
2. the block of the layout sketch at x 925-1155, y 585-720 of the 1920x1080 frame (48-60 % from the left, 54-67 % from the top): a low brushed-steel swing gate closing the gap in the handrail in front of the open cabin, with a small green arrow lamp on its left post.
3. the block of the layout sketch at x 1445-1655, y 330-565 of the 1920x1080 frame (75-86 % from the left, 31-52 % from the top): a framed map board on the pillar showing two lift sections as a blue and a red line joined at a middle station dot, with simple mountain contours; the only words on it may be "CHOPOK" at the top end, otherwise no text.
NPC zone at x 1215-1365, y 490-790 of the 1920x1080 frame (63-71 % from the left, 45-73 % from the top): an animated character sprite will stand here later, so paint only plain, uncluttered background in it - no person, no figure, no silhouette, no clothes on hooks that read as a person. The character's feet stand on the floor at y 790.
the area of the layout sketch at x 0-160, y 380-725 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-8 % from the left, 35-67 % from the top) is the open passage with daylight at the left end of the hall. the area of the layout sketch at x 960-1160, y 330-585 of the 1920x1080 frame (50-60 % from the left, 31-54 % from the top) is the open doors of cabin 2.

Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1920, y 724-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top) is the light grey concrete boarding platform - one continuous flat surface with no step, no edge and nothing standing on it: no barriers, no stands, no bins, no people. Only daylight patches, soft shadows and a few concrete joints.

Fiction rules: no company or resort logos (no TMR, no JASNÁ, no www addresses), no warning stickers with text, no cabin livery; the only lettering in the picture is the place name CHOPOK on the hanging sign and on the map. No people (the attendant is a separate sprite), no animals.

The layout sketch is a blocking aid only: paint over all of it. Do NOT draw frames, borders, outlines or boxes around objects, and keep no flat colour block. The finished picture contains no UI, no captions, no text except what is asked for above, no watermark and no people or animals unless stated above.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
